task_plan: Step 1: Reconstruct the report's core divergence logic with simple price-extension proxies, starting from trailing 24h return and relative-high versus VWAP signals.
Step 2: Reconstruct the momentum-weakening leg with short-vs-medium horizon return slope and MACD-style divergence proxies, keeping expressions simple and interpretable.
Step 3: Add lightweight exhaustion confirmation using intrabar spread stress and weakening 24h volume change, while avoiding thresholds and complex multi-variable filters in the first round.

Price_Extension_24H_Rank.description: Cross-sectional ranking of the last 24h return, used as the simplest proxy for ongoing price extension in a late-trend state.

variables.$close: Close price of the crypto asset.
variables.TS_PCTCHANGE(A, p): Percentage change in sequence A over p periods.

Short_vs_Medium_Momentum_Deceleration.description: Difference between 24h trailing return strength and longer-window return strength, used to capture whether the recent move is losing acceleration relative to the broader trend.

variables.$close: Close price of the crypto asset.
variables.TS_PCTCHANGE(A, p): Percentage change in sequence A over p periods.

MACD_Price_Divergence_Proxy.description: Difference between ranked price extension and ranked MACD strength, used as a crypto proxy for price continuing while momentum weakens.

variables.$close: Close price of the crypto asset.
variables.TS_PCTCHANGE(A, p): Percentage change in sequence A over p periods.
variables.MACD(A, short_window, long_window): Moving Average Convergence Divergence of sequence A.

Relative_High_VWAP_Deviation.description: Cross-sectional ranking of close relative to VWAP, used to identify assets trading at stretched levels compared with their local average traded price.

variables.$close: Close price of the crypto asset.
variables.$vwap: Volume-weighted average price of the asset.

Trend_Extension_with_Spread_Stress.description: Interaction between recent price extension and current high-low spread, used to capture unstable continuation in a late-trend phase.

variables.$close: Close price of the crypto asset.
variables.TS_PCTCHANGE(A, p): Percentage change in sequence A over p periods.

Price_Up_Volume_Not_Confirming.description: Difference between ranked price extension and ranked 24h volume change, used to capture continued price strength without volume confirmation.

variables.$close: Close price of the crypto asset.
variables.TS_PCTCHANGE(A, p): Percentage change in sequence A over p periods.
